title: Nadan sakina meri nadan sakina
body:
Nadan sakina meri nadan sakina  (4)
Tujpe kurban meri jaan sakina....
Nadan sakina ....
(1) So jao mere sene pe kuch der ko beti   (2)
Hona hai mere bad pareshan...ha pareshan sakina
Meri nadan sakina....
(2) Kharo bhari raho pe safar karke meri jaan (2)
Jana hai tujhe sham ke zindan..haye zindan sakina
Meri nadan sakina....
(3) Halqum pe jis dum mere chal jayega khanjar..(2)
Tharaega us waqt ye maidan..haye maidan sakina
Meri nadan sakina..
(4) Sar katke kardenge udu lash ko pamal...(2)
Ho jayegi mushkil meri pahechan... sakina
Meri nadan sakina..
(5) Wo qufe ki galiya vo sitam garo ka majma...(2)
Pathhar tujhe marenge musalman...sakina.
Meri nadan sakina..
(6) Ab jina yatimo ki tarha sikhlo beti.... (2)
Kuch der ke him aur hai maheman .....sakina...
Meri nadan sakina..
(7) Padte rahe "Rehan"aur "Suhail" aapka noha (2)
Likhte rahe noha tera Imaran...haye imran sakina..
Meri nadan sakina...
Nadan sakina meri nadan sakina..... (4)
